what: cold compile time (lowering + XLA compilation of a fresh process) of the shipped programs: (1) a pre-registered gate of a cyclic-offset enumeration of the stream pairs of the residual-Gram module against the previous enumeration (not adopted: the gate failed), (2) XLA configuration variants (Triton GEMM off, autotune level 0, persistent compilation cache) on the shipped programs of eight derivative families and the strongest control of each, (3) the small-D forward ridge pathology under autotune level 0, (4) calibration attribution of the compile cost to the layer count
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes per method and cell
protocol.cold_compile: lowering time + XLA compilation time, measured in a fresh process (no persistent cache unless the variant says so); steady state = median of 51 samples after 3 warmups
protocol.statistic: ratio = previous / new (or default / variant, as labelled) per cell, paired by repetition on the log scale; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3))
protocol.gate: a default would change only where (a) the steady-state lower95 of previous / new >= 0.95 in every changed cell, (b) outputs agree within 1e-13 (relative; norms and 64 sampled entries), (c) the cold-compile lower95 >= 1 in every changed cell
protocol.qualification: every method in every group qualified on a reduced instance against a 50-digit oracle before it is timed
protocol.fairness: same cells, parameters, points and targets for every method; the library sets no global XLA flag; every variant is set by the caller, per process or per compilation

gate.what: cyclic-offset stream pairing (K = S + S^T, one batched product of identical shape per offset) vs the previous enumeration (one stream against all later streams per product), residual-Gram module, T = D + 2 streams per point; cells with T < 6 run identical programs (measurement floor)
gate.decision: not adopted: the pre-registered gate failed (steady-state lower95 minimum 0.789, compile lower95 minimum 0.552, gn-step deviation up to 3.6e-09 against 1e-13); the enumeration stays in the module as an exact, tested, non-default code path
gate.strata_note: post hoc, not part of the gate. Gram and residual outputs agree to <= 4e-16 in every cell; the larger deviations are of the damped Gauss-Newton step, where a rounding-level difference of K is amplified by the conditioning of K + 1e-3 I

configuration.what: default vs variant per program (shipped candidate and strongest control of each family): ratio = variant / default for the cold compile and for the steady-state median (<1 = variant faster)

variants.notriton: environment flag XLA_FLAGS=--xla_gpu_enable_triton_gemm=false in the process that compiles the program
variants.autotune0: compilation option xla_gpu_autotune_level = 0 passed to that program's compile() call
variants.cache: private persistent compilation cache (JAX_COMPILATION_CACHE_DIR, minimum compile time 0 s); compile ratio of the first (cold, cache-writing) run, warm_over_cold = a second fresh process reading the cache over the cold compile

pathology.what: forward-only ridge programs at small input dimension (D = 3, one layer, B = 2^19-2^20): XLA autotuning of an input-reduce fusion dominates the cold compile; default vs autotune level 0

attribution_calibration.what: calibration, not a claim: cold compile against the layer count (2-16 layers) of the shipped programs, linear fit per program; and the compile ratios of the variants on the 51 of 54 programs of the same families with a complete variant set (a different seed from the frozen run)
